problem_type: A canvas generation-mode projection can remain stale after an input-removing write, including writes persisted while the project is not open.
symptom: A node can remain in a reference or single-image mode after its last reference is removed, including when an external disk-gateway write occurs while the project is closed and the stale snapshot is later loaded.
direct_cause: The session subscription only had a previous/current transition to compare and the load path had no state-only convergence. The old component effect was removed, so persisted nodes and offline writes had no shared load boundary that could recover a stuck mode.
class_root: The shared boundary lacked one input fact covering pending edges, node-owned slots/links and planned storyboard first frames, plus two trigger invariants: ordinary writes revert only on live-to-empty transitions, while load and event-tail replay run the same state convergence once after projection.
affected_population: Video first-frame, last-frame and first-last workflows built through multi-step quick actions or Agent/storyboard writes
Director camera-reference writes and any future caller that creates an edge before explicitly setting the target mode
All store/document writes that remove the final reference input while the composer is closed
Legacy and offline disk snapshots loaded after the project was not in the renderer
entry_points: All nodes/edges store and document writes are observed by the subscription, which compares previous/current input facts; load and load-tail call the same convergence after projection.
The connect gesture paths call deriveTargetAfterConnect; promotion remains there.
Undo/redo restore complete snapshots through canvasDocumentCommit and bypass derived reversion during the replay write; load convergence uses history:false.

external_sources.purpose: React recommends calculating derived state from existing state and moving event-caused writes to event/shared boundaries instead of an Effect.
ComfyUI documents connect and disconnect as graph operations on node inputs.
Blender documents dragging a link away as disconnecting the socket and restoring an unconnected input.

invariants: A live input is any admitted non-text reference edge (pending or resolved), a node-owned reference link/slot fill, or a planned storyboard keyframe for the target shot.
The subscription reverts only when the same target was live before the write and empty after it; an already-empty target is untouched.
Promotion is performed only by the connect gesture through deriveTargetAfterConnect and resolveTargetModeForEdge.
Undo/redo restore snapshots without a second mode projection; load and load-tail convergence use history:false and remain idempotent.

door_reduction.why_not: The input-reducing user, Agent and document doors remain required and still converge through the store subscription. The two surviving mode owners are intentionally separate: promoteTargetMode is the connect-gesture write door, while revertTargetModeForEmptyInputs is the all-store-writes empty-input door; merging them recreates the intermediate-state overwrite. Submit and paid-card readers remain separate defensive consumers.

generality_proof: Every input-reducing caller mutates the same nodes/edges store identity and is observed by the subscription; the shared predicate treats unresolved edges, node-owned slots and planned keyframes as inputs, so caller, provider result timing, import format and UI mount do not change the result. Undo/redo is a separate authoritative snapshot boundary, so its explicit empty modes are preserved.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the single input predicate and apply text reversion only after a proven live-to-empty transition.
Compare the target in the previous and current store snapshots and invoke reversion only on the transition.
Own the connect-gesture postcondition and its sole promotion decision.
Apply the same state-based empty-input convergence once after load and event-tail replay without creating undo history.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Promotion and empty-input reversion are separate explicit functions at the shared canvas derivation boundary; the store subscription is only the trigger for reversion.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The class regression test loads a stale snapshot, applies a disk-gateway write, and replays an edge-removal tail; both converge through convergeStuckInputModes.
The subscription sees the edge-array change and class tests cover last-edge removal and atomic undo.
The class tests execute the same add-node, edge-write and explicit mode-write order used by the recipe and keep its edge roles.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: original first-frame projection and batch confirmation
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The two baseline storyboard failures are reproduced before the fix and the full creation directory is rerun after the fix.
The class test models a director video reference edge followed by an explicit target mode write; the subscription no longer re-promotes it.
Submit-time reconciliation remains a defensive reader-side fallback and is unchanged; promotion stays in the connect gesture as required by the approved direction.
The paid-card projection is outside this canvas line and no card code is changed.

recurrence.reason: Any current or future caller that writes an edge and then an explicit mode can expose the same intermediate-state overwrite if promotion is attached to the all-writes subscription. Any caller that removes the final reference or persists a stale snapshot while the project is closed can expose stale mode if reversion and load convergence leave the shared boundary.
same_class_scan: src/workbench/generationCanvas/store/canvasModeFollowsInputs.test.ts covers disconnect, source deletion, uploaded-reference removal, restore, undo and explicit first/last/first-last/director writes.
src/workbench/generationCanvas/store/canvasModeConvergeOnLoad.test.ts covers old data, disk-gateway offline edge removal, event-tail removal, unresolved upstream edges and planned first frames.

prevention.invariant: For ordinary writes, a target is eligible only on a live-to-empty transition; load and load-tail run the same shared input predicate after projection for every empty single/edit/character node, while history replay remains authoritative.
prevention.failure_mode: If no archetype, no compatible text mode or no live input fact can be established, no speculative mode switch occurs; existing capability admission and submit-time reconciliation remain responsible for reporting unusable generation.
prevention.strategy: Keep promotion at deriveTargetAfterConnect, compute liveInputNodeIds once per state in canvasConnectDerivations, compare both snapshots at the store boundary, and call convergeStuckInputModes after load and load-tail while guarding complete undo/redo replacement with the document commit replay marker.

legacy_paths.rationale: The obsolete composer effect and component-only write path were removed earlier. This change removes the single-image exception, removes post-write promotion from the subscription, and adds no fallback; undo/redo is explicitly marked as an authoritative snapshot path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency decides Nomi's archetype modes or reference slots; React guidance informed removal of the effect but no dependency change is needed.

migration: No stored schema migration is needed. Existing snapshots keep their nodes, edges and mode ids; load and load-tail now converge stuck single/edit/character modes, ordinary input-removing writes still reconcile only on a live-to-empty transition, and undo/redo restores the stored snapshot as-is.
residual_risks: 中英真实 Electron 走查和截图逐张复核已在最终构建上完成；不跑真实供应商付费任务。
600 节点拖动场景因真实抓手被 react-flow__nodesselection-rect 遮挡而无数据；临时 Vitest 已量到写后订阅在 600 节点上的位置写入跳过、meta 写入额外开销仍低于 2ms，跨平台旧基线与同平台安静基线仍可能有差异。
规划首帧的识别依赖分镜节点的 storyboardDesignId + shotId + storyboardKeyframe 绑定；未绑定的外部计划数据不会被猜测。
